name: about-whyus
blurb: Why-us section highlighting company values and differentiators.
description: An about/why-us section template showcasing company values, benefits, and differentiators through visual content and messaging. Designed for emphasizing competitive advantages.
use_when: Landing pages and about sections where companies need to articulate values and competitive advantages.
avoid_when: When custom values and content are needed; uses hardcoded layout and messaging.
a11y: Semantic HTML with images and text; scroll-triggered motion animations.
